errors.quote: Let $p$ be the precision in bits, $2\le s<t<2^p$ coprime lengths, $\alpha<\sqrt p$ an integer width
errors.problem: The paper's lemma requires $p>100$ and $2\le\alpha$. Without $p>100$, the page's later "$16p<p^2$" fails for $p\le16$.

errors.quote: adjacent interchanges of $\ell$- or $(\ell-1)$-bit address fields, each $O(Tp(1+\ell^\tau))$ by [fast address-chunk interchange](address-chunk-interchange.md)
errors.problem: The chunk interchange (paper Lemma chunk-swap) swaps fields of equal width. To swap an $\ell$-bit field with an $(\ell-1)$-bit one, the paper first splits off a leading bit, swaps the equal-width pieces, and moves the bit with the elementary stream lemma. Only then is the cost $O(Tp(1+\ell^\tau))$.

errors.quote: so polynomial setup per line is $o(Tp)$
errors.problem: This holds only under the paper's assumptions that $r$ grows faster than every polynomial in $p$ and $d$ is polynomially bounded in $p$, which give the ratio $O(dp^{c-1}/r)\to0$. The page states it unconditionally.
